title: How Long Does Structural Drying Take?
description: How long structural drying takes depends on the materials, how long they stayed wet, and the equipment used. Here is what sets the timeline.
author: Example Restoration Co.
html:
How Long Structural Drying Takes in a Typical Home

Surfaces dry first. Subfloors, framing, and insulation hold water much longer, which is why drying is measured, not guessed.

What Changes the Timeline

Material type, how long it stayed wet, and airflow all matter. Read what to do after a burst pipe for the first steps.
